description: Report a page to DechoNet: phishing or brand impersonation, a fake payment window (card fields where a payment provider should be), hidden instructions aimed at AI agents, a malicious download, a DechoNet verdict that looks wrong (false_positive) or a danger it missed (missed), an MCP server whose tool descriptions steer agents (malicious_mcp — url is the MCP endpoint), or a network anomaly (network_anomaly — the certificate serial/issuer or addresses you saw for the host, in observed). Kept for 90 days: the host and the kind, with an anonymous reporter hash used to count independent reports; for malicious_mcp the endpoint path, for network_anomaly the observed values and the country of the connection. No query, page text or free text. A report changes no verdict by itself: DechoNet opens the page itself and only what it observes counts; pages reported by several independent sources are looked at first. Not read-only (it records the report); rate-limited.

kind.description: What is wrong with the page

observed.description: network_anomaly only: the certificate serial (hex) and issuer, and the addresses, you saw for the host

url.description: Address of the page (only its host is kept)

name: report_page

receipts.description: Signed observation receipts behind this result, one per lookup: when, from where and under which rules version DechoNet observed it. Each url shows the record and checks its Ed25519 signature.

title: Report a Page
